name: Kim Fields
bio: Kim Victoria Fields-Morgan (formerly Freeman; born May 12, 1969) is an American actress and director. She is best known for her roles as Dorothy 'Tootie' Ramsey on the NBC sitcom The Facts of Life (1979–1988), Lydia Haley on the miniseries Roots: The Next Generations, Regine Hunter on the FOX sitcom Living Single (1993–1998), Regina on Netflix's The Upshaws, and Rhoda on SkyOne's Living the Dream. She also competed on Dancing with the Stars.
place: New York City, New York, USA
